decisions.reason: The two-component glass flake system builds on the firm's core spraying expertise and represents real engineering investment, and one year on the market is too short to judge results, so dropping it would write off sunk development costs without clear evidence of failure.

The low-pressure injection pump sits close to the established offer, has a dedicated web page signalling public commitment, and costs little to maintain within the existing range, so there is no reason to withdraw it.

Although it is only mentioned on the website, the transfer pump fits the firm's material-conveying portfolio and shares production know-how, so keeping it costs little while dropping it would write off the development effort.

Fire protection flow monitoring is visibly presented on its own page and matches the firm's announced digitalization direction, so management would attribute any slow uptake to early-market conditions and persist.
